notes: Microchip PK2CMD licence clause 1(b) permits distributing a modified version for use with Microchip products provided the fixed copyright and modified-by notice is shown prominently. patches/0001-fill-the-modified-by-notice.patch fills the placeholder Microchip's own banner carries, so the notice appears where end users see it, and the build refuses to package a binary whose banner does not match. Upstream is jaka-fi/pk2cmd (kair.us), the maintained fork, not cjacker/pk2cmd-minus, idle since 2023. PK2DeviceFile.dat ships beside the binary because pk2cmd resolves it by searching PATH. It is Microchip's own 1.62.14 file, not the one in the jaka-fi tree: jaka-fi pulled that file on 2026-09-27 after a copyright claim from the PICkitPlus team over the entries they added, and Microchip's predates PICkitPlus. It covers every curated beta part; the MSB-first (MSB1st) parts it lacks need a 2.63.222+ file the user supplies (epic-tools#6). The licence has no SPDX identifier, so the manifest omits the license field and the shipped license.txt carries the terms. The package version maps upstream tag v1.27.01 to 1.27.1 (the leading zero is dropped), because package.json needs valid semver while the upstream tag does not use it.
